name: ernestdefoe/lobby
description: Lobby — a dark-first community theme for Flarum 2. Tags become #channels in a left sidebar with unread dots and mention badges, discussions read as chat-style rows with a "new since your last visit" divider, and an Online list sits on the right.

suggest.flarum/tags: Tags become the #channels in the sidebar. Without it the sidebar shows Activity and Messages only.
suggest.flarum/mentions: Mention badges on channels in the sidebar.
suggest.flarum/messages: A Messages link with an unread badge in the sidebar and the phone tab bar.
suggest.flarum/sticky: The Pinned chip on discussion rows.
suggest.ernestdefoe/presence: What each person in the Online list is doing, under their name.
suggest.fof/forum-widgets-core: The Online list is offered as a widget.
suggest.ernestdefoe/wardrobe: Run Lobby next to other themes and let members choose.

scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Sets up a database for use with integration tests. Execute this only once.
